description: Find when a website’s domain was registered and transferred, until when, and at which registrar. Answers from the registry's last RDAP answer we stored, for over 6 million domains. A .com or .net domain never looked up is asked at its registry during the call; other domains answer only from stored answers. A subdomain answers for the domain it belongs to. A recently registered or transferred domain often means a new business or a new owner. Charges 0.05 credits when the registry knows the domain; a miss is free.
name: websites_find_domain_registration

checkedAt.description: When the registry answered; null when it was never asked

domain.description: The registered domain that was looked up

found.description: true when the registry knows the domain

transferredAt.description: When the domain last moved to another registrar

title: Find when a website’s domain was registered and transferred, until when, and at which registrar
